  [Schools of Science, Engineering, Business & Management, and Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies - Undergraduate Minor Program in Entrepreneurship]

caveats: To graduate with a minor in Entrepreneurship, the students must have enrolled in the Minor Program and completed a minimum total of 18 credits and all of its requirements, as well as all the requirements of their major program of study. For students admitted in 2016-17 or after, they are also required to attain an average grade point of at least 2.5 in courses taken within the Minor Program. For credit transfer, students can transfer a maximum total of 6 credits to the Minor Program. Out of the total credits required by the minor program, at least 9 credits should be single-counted within the minor and are not used to fulfill any other requirements for graduation except the 120-credit degree Students may use no more than 9 credits earned from courses delivered in online mode, including HKUST self-paced online [SPO] courses and other online credits approved through the University’s credit transfer procedures, to satisfy the graduation requirements of a degree program.

Entrepreneurship Electives (Courses from the specified elective list, of which at least 6 credits from each area. Students may use at most 6 credits from ENTR 4901-4904 to count towards this elective requirement.) -- the credits and the course count are checked, but the extra condition in this sentence is not. Confirm it with your advisor.
IEDA 2200: The course was last offered in 2021-22 and was deleted subsequently.
Elective(s): IEDA 2200 is named in the requirement PDF but not in the 2026-27 course catalog, so it was left out of this check.
